title.en: Démocratisation of AI All Around the World to Shape the Future AGI
title.zh: AI 的全球普及：塑造未来 AGI

content.en:
Artificial General Intelligence will not be shaped by a handful of labs in a handful of countries — it will be shaped by the collective intelligence, values, and contributions of people from every corner of the world. But today, access to AI development, education, and governance is deeply unequal.

Feliana Citradewi presents the work of Global AI Assembly in building inclusive, globally distributed AI communities and the practical steps needed to democratise AI development beyond the current concentration in the US, Europe, and China. The talk covers grassroots AI education, open-source as an equaliser, governance frameworks that include underrepresented voices, and what it would actually take to ensure that the future of AGI reflects all of humanity.
content.zh:
通用人工智能不会由少数几个国家的少数实验室塑造——它将由世界各地人们的集体智慧、价值观和贡献来塑造。然而今天，参与 AI 开发、教育和治理的机会极度不平等。

演讲者介绍 Global AI Assembly 在构建包容性、全球分布式 AI 社区方面的工作，以及将 AI 开发民主化所需的实践步骤，探讨开源作为均衡器的作用，以及确保 AGI 未来反映全人类需要采取的措施。
content.fr:
L'intelligence artificielle générale ne sera pas façonnée par une poignée de laboratoires dans une poignée de pays — elle sera façonnée par l'intelligence collective, les valeurs et les contributions de personnes du monde entier. Pourtant, l'accès au développement, à l'éducation et à la gouvernance de l'IA reste profondément inégal.

Feliana Citradewi présente le travail de Global AI Assembly pour construire des communautés IA inclusives et mondialement distribuées, et les étapes pratiques pour démocratiser le développement de l'IA au-delà de sa concentration actuelle.

title.en: SGLang: High-Performance Serving Framework for LLMs and Multimodal Models
title.zh: SGLang：面向 LLM 和多模态模型的高性能服务框架

content.en:
SGLang is an open-source high-performance serving framework designed for large language models and multimodal models. At its core, SGLang introduces RadixAttention — a novel KV cache management technique that enables efficient prefix sharing across requests — alongside a highly optimised CUDA kernel library and a flexible batching engine that maximises GPU utilisation.

Xinyuan Tong presents the technical foundations of SGLang, the key algorithmic and systems innovations that give it its performance edge, and how the maintainer community has scaled the project to support dozens of model architectures including the latest multimodal and reasoning models. The session includes a deep dive into the serving stack, a live demo, and practical guidance on deploying SGLang for production workloads.
content.zh: SGLang 是专为大语言模型和多模态模型设计的开源高性能服务框架。其核心创新 RadixAttention 是一种新颖的 KV 缓存管理技术，支持跨请求的高效前缀共享，配合高度优化的 CUDA 内核库和灵活的批处理引擎，最大化 GPU 利用率。
content.fr: SGLang est un framework de service open source haute performance conçu pour les grands modèles de langage et les modèles multimodaux. Au cœur de SGLang, RadixAttention est une technique novatrice de gestion du cache KV permettant un partage efficace des préfixes entre les requêtes.

title.en: SGLang Diffusion: A High-Performance Inference Framework for Image and Video Generation
title.zh: SGLang Diffusion：面向图像和视频生成的高性能推理框架

content.en:
SGLang has established itself as a leading serving framework for large language models, and SGLang Diffusion extends that performance to the world of image and video generation. This session presents the architecture and key innovations behind SGLang Diffusion, which brings the same throughput optimisations, batching strategies, and memory management techniques that made SGLang fast for LLMs to diffusion-based generative models.

Yuhao Yang covers the unique challenges of serving diffusion models at scale — multi-step inference, variable resolution, and the memory footprint of large UNet and transformer-based denoisers — and shows how SGLang Diffusion addresses them. Attendees will see benchmarks comparing SGLang Diffusion against existing solutions and learn how to integrate it into their own image and video generation pipelines.
content.zh: SGLang 已成为大语言模型的领先服务框架，而 SGLang Diffusion 将这一性能扩展到图像和视频生成领域。本次会议介绍 SGLang Diffusion 的架构和关键创新，将 LLM 高吞吐量优化、批处理策略和内存管理技术应用于扩散式生成模型。
content.fr: SGLang s'est imposé comme un framework de service de premier plan pour les grands modèles de langage, et SGLang Diffusion étend cette performance aux domaines de la génération d'images et de vidéos.

title.en: RL Training Lab: Building a High-Performance RL Pipeline with SGLang
title.zh: RL 训练实验室：用 SGLang 构建高性能强化学习流水线
title.fr: RL Training Lab : Construire un pipeline RL haute performance avec SGLang

content.en:
Reinforcement learning post-training has become a critical stage in building capable foundation models — yet most open-source practitioners still struggle to set up a stable, high-throughput RL pipeline. This hands-on lab brings SGLang's battle-tested RL infrastructure directly to the GOSIM Paris community. Attendees will walk through building an end-to-end RL training loop using SGLang as the rollout backend, learn how to integrate it with the Miles framework, and tackle real challenges like training-inference mismatch and rollout efficiency at scale. SGLang today powers RL post-training for frontier models across the industry, running on over 400,000 GPUs worldwide. This session distills that production experience into practical, reproducible techniques — giving open-source developers and researchers a concrete path to running robust RL training on their own infrastructure.

The lab will cover: SGLang as a rollout backend for RL training, SGLang x Miles framework integration, practical techniques for handling training-inference distribution shift, and rollout efficiency optimization. Designed for ML engineers and researchers with LLM deployment experience who want to move into RL post-training workflows. Speaker: Ethan Su, SGLang core developer and RL infrastructure lead at LMSYS Org.

content.en:
Capabilities of modern hardware are oftentimes underexploited in popular software libraries. Scikit-learn has grown into an industry standard with user-friendly APIs and well-known idioms that users love, but data analytics pipelines oftentimes require a stepup in efficiency and performance.
 
Extension for scikit-learn addresses these gaps by proposing optimized alternatives to selected algorithms without any significant code changes on the user side.
 
This talk will demonstrate how to make machine learning workflows run efficiently by leveraging the UXL Extension for scikit-learn, and will dive into the details of how this works behind the scenes and avenues for future integrations.

content.en: Training state-of-the-art language models typically demands vast proprietary datasets and closed pipelines. At Pleias, we take a different path — building open, high-performing LLMs using synthetic data environments designed for the commons. This talk presents our approach to constructing synthetic data pipelines that generate diverse, high-quality training corpora without relying on proprietary sources. We cover the technical architecture behind our synthetic environments, the training strategies that enable competitive performance on standard benchmarks, and why we believe open synthetic data is a critical piece of the puzzle for democratizing access to frontier AI capabilities. I'll focus on the viability of production deployments in real-world tasks, on the technical side of building and running evals in these cases using Harbor (https://github.com/laude-institute/harbor), and how we are using these techniques at ellamind to build agents that are reliable and provably safe.

content.en:
As the Founder and CEO of QuantStack - the leading contributor to the Jupyter Project - I present the latest advancements in the Jupyter ecosystem. Key innovations include Jupyter-AI and collaborative editing workflows, but the most transformative is JupyterLite, the most scalable Jupyter distribution, bringing interactive computing to millions of users worldwide.

We introduce the notebook link platform, a powerful solution for sharing Jupyter-based documents at scale, from notebooks and storymaps to CAD models and blog posts. The platform features multi-language support (Python, R, C++, GNU Octave, OCaml, Haskell, SQLite, and more) and an AI assistant workflow with advanced tool-calling capabilities.

A major breakthrough is in-browser tool calling in JupyterLite AI, which brings the full power of Jupyter-AI to lightweight, browser-based workflows. This approach ensures both scalability and enhanced security, as all computations and AI interactions are contained within the browser sandbox.

For education, the platform enables automatic notebook grading and LMS integration, making it ideal for interactive teaching and assessment.
